title: The thesis promise
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Composition II, week three. The instructor returns the first papers. Wood didn't write one. He hands in the strip about her and she grades it.

panels.composition: The classroom. The INSTRUCTOR handing back papers along the rows. WOOD in the back with no paper to receive.

image.prompt: a community college classroom with an instructor handing back papers along rows of adult students, a young man in the back row with empty hands, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood sliding a quarter-letter digest across the desk toward her instead.

image.prompt: close on a young man's hand sliding a small stapled photocopied booklet across a desk, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The instructor reading it standing up. The class watching her read.

image.prompt: a woman instructor standing in a classroom aisle reading a small photocopied booklet while adult students watch, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The digest handed back. In red pen on the cover: B+. Under it: 'Thesis is implied. State it.'

image.prompt: close on a small photocopied booklet with a grade written on its cover in red pen and a short note beneath, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: B+ · 'Thesis is implied. State it.'

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: She grades the strip. B+. The red pen is not Chloe's, and he notices that it isn't.
